senses.gloss: f. = רַעֲוָא I, pleasure, will; good will; ambition.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 12:2">Targ. Prov. XII, 2</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 23:8">Targ. Y. Gen. XXIII, 8</cite> (O. <cite ref="T00884"><he>רעוא</he></cite>); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 107:30">Targ. Ps. CVII, 30</cite> <he>רְעוּתְהוֹן</he> Ms. (ed. <he>רַעֲיָיתְ׳</he>, <he>רַעֲיָתְ׳</he>).—Constr. frequ. <he>רַעֲוַת</he>, <he>רַעֲוַות</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 23:20">Targ. I Sam. XXIII, 20</cite> (h. text <cite ref="A00939"><he>אַוַּת</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 145:18">Targ. Ps. CXLV, 18</cite> <he>רעוות</he> Ms. (ed. <cite ref="T00886"><he>רְעוּת</he></cite>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7b:10">Snh. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>ברְעוּת נפשיה</he> of his own free will, v. <cite ref="R00024"><he>צְבוּ</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 3:1">Lev. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to <he>רעות רוח</he>, <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 4:6">Koh. IV, 6</cite>) <he>רְעוּתֵיה דמתקרי וכ׳</he> it is his ambition to be called &c.; a. fr.
